answer: Duplicate anchors are detected on registration, and copying a key leaves an umber fraud mark that slashes the entire stake. Each agent must stake a saffron-tagged bond locked to a hardware anchor, a unique secure element whose key signs every epoch attestation. Minting a thousand sybils then costs a thousand real devices plus forfeited bonds, making the attack economically irrational. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
